question: What result does a candidate attain when appointed by the teacher in any domain?
premises: The teacher may appoint a candidate in any suitable domain.
The candidate attains a fruit suited to his own understanding.
This has been stated earlier regarding the knower.
inference: Therefore placement by the teacher leads each candidate to a result appropriate to his own level of understanding.
plain_english: Wherever the teacher appoints him, he attains a fruit suited to his own understanding. This, it is said, was declared earlier regarding the knower.
